name: TestimonialCard
summary: Customer quote card. Composes a quotation, an author (avatar + name + role + company), and optional rating / metric. Used on landing pages, sales decks, case study previews. Operator-flavor (compact, neutral) and marketing-flavor (large, optional accent left-edge stroke).

rules: Rating renders with aria-label='4.6 of 5 stars' so SR users hear the value, not a parade of glyphs.

do: Lead with the quote in type.heading.h3 weight; author meta in type.body.sm.
Use synthetic operator names in marketing fixtures (per v0.12.5 privacy hygiene).
Pair with a single metric when there's a quantifiable outcome.
Marketing variant gets a 2 px text.accent left-edge stroke.
dont: Don't render quotes longer than ~80 words. Trim or link out.
Don't use real customer names without permission — use synthetic operator names in design fixtures.
